title: Beat: everything waiting on you, already drafted
excerpt: The Beat beta is open. An AI agent that finds the work waiting on you and drafts the next step. Free during the beta.
content_html:
Security

Before you connect anything

Nothing posts without youEvery review, ticket, comment and Slack message waits for your approval.

We never store your codeIt's read transiently for the review, then dropped.

Not used for trainingYour data doesn't train AI models. Encrypted in transit and at rest.

Your queue is yoursYour manager can't see what you approve or dismiss.

Prompt injection can't act through Beat: the worst a hidden instruction in a PR can do is change a draft you read first. Hosted by CXAI on Google Cloud. Full security details

Proof

Recorded by the engineers who build it

More: Copilot vs. BugBot vs. Beat on the same PR · Jira ticket analyzer · Why Beat beats a personal agent setup

Questions

Quick answers

No. Every draft waits in your queue until you approve, edit or dismiss it.

Keep using them; we do. They answer when you ask and bring the context. Beat starts before you ask, the moment a ticket is assigned, a PR opens or a meeting ends, and it works the same way for everyone on your team.

No. It's useful on your own from day one, and it compounds when your team joins: what you approve lands in the next person's queue.

No. It reviews pull requests and drafts tickets, comments and messages. Your coding assistant writes the code.

Free during the beta. Paid plans start January 1, 2027, and beta users hear about pricing first.

More questions answered at cxapp.com/beat.
